name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, and findings
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Then exercise the severity pill row: click the CRITICAL pill (single-select filter), confirm the critical finding stays, click it again (filter cleared) and confirm the WARNING finding returns. Clicking the timeline's agent name scrolls the run's accordion into view first — agent-browser clicks dispatch at element coordinates, which miss below the 577px fold. Locator notes: accessible names concatenate child spans WITHOUT spaces ('Critical1'), and `wait --text` matches the CSS-uppercased accessible text. Exercises ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — run via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
